items.stem: A silver-streak investigation found inconsistent hopper-dryer and barrel settings. Which intervention was actually followed by the large defect reduction?
options: Optimise drying/barrel temperatures and standardise machine settings
items.correct_answer: Optimise drying/barrel temperatures and standardise machine settings
items.rationale: The corrective-action case reported these process/drying changes before defects fell from 197 to 28 and then 14.

items.stem: After an ejector/mould redesign, the defect rate changed from 7.19% to 2.06%. What is the most defensible conclusion?
options: The tooling redesign was associated with a large reduction in defective products
items.correct_answer: The tooling redesign was associated with a large reduction in defective products
items.rationale: The reported defect rate fell by about 71%, with sigma improving from 3.82 to 4.25.

items.stem: In the Six Sigma incomplete-moulding case, which outcome best demonstrates verified improvement?
options: Defect rate fell to about one quarter and sigma rose 3.91→4.31
items.correct_answer: Defect rate fell to about one quarter and sigma rose 3.91→4.31

items.stem: An automotive injection-moulding SMED workshop reduced setup from 48:30 to 29:41. Approximately what improvement was reported?
items.rationale: The study reports a 38.8% setup-time reduction.

items.stem: Which change is characteristic of the 450-ton PT MWT SMED intervention?
options: Converting internal setup tasks to external tasks where possible
items.correct_answer: Converting internal setup tasks to external tasks where possible
items.rationale: That is a core SMED action used in the reported 196→156 minute changeover reduction.

items.stem: Why is the TPM + SMED + ML case useful but not a pure injection-moulding validation family?
options: The plant included both injection and blow moulding
items.correct_answer: The plant included both injection and blow moulding
items.rationale: Its mixed-process context should be preserved in provenance.

items.stem: A Taguchi optimisation reduced shrinkage defects from 982 to 92 per roughly 7,000 molded parts. Which defect-rate change was reported?
items.rationale: Visual QC and dimensional measurement confirmed the reported reduction.

items.stem: In the NSGA-II production trial, why was accepting 3 gas-trap-burn defects potentially better than forcing gas-trap burn to zero?
options: The balanced solution achieved zero short shots and sink marks and minimized overall scrap trade-offs
Gas-trap burn is never a defect
Flash and sink mark cannot interact with settings
items.correct_answer: The balanced solution achieved zero short shots and sink marks and minimized overall scrap trade-offs
items.rationale: Single-defect optimization created trade-offs; the balanced NSGA-II solution produced 3 GTB but 0 short shots and 0 sink marks in 300 parts.

items.stem: The Toshiba IS 450 GSW OEE case improved from 26.43% to 78.87%. What target did the improved machine exceed?
items.rationale: The reported post-improvement OEE exceeded the company's 75% target.

items.stem: Which REACT-5 result most directly strengthens MouldMaster's future expert-label pipeline?
options: Independent process-engineer label audits with >90% agreement plus cycle/MES/root-cause traceability
items.correct_answer: Independent process-engineer label audits with >90% agreement plus cycle/MES/root-cause traceability
items.rationale: REACT-5 demonstrates audited human root-cause labeling and full traceability, not merely more sensor volume.
